title: Developing a Toxicity Detection Communication App: Promoting Positive Dialogue with AI Ethics, React, and TensorFlow.js
author: Daniel Kliewer

claims.text: Yet here we are again, seeing advanced technologies—drones, AI, cryptographic frameworks—funneled into machines of war

to improve healthcare delivery in remote areas, or augmented reality can train doctors more efficiently, the tools we create can heal rather than harm. This choice—how we apply our technology— is ours to make

’s project: a small web application that uses machine learning and a graph-based data structure to help people communicate more positively. Instead of guiding deadly precision strikes, this codebase is designed to guide more constructive dialogue

We’re acknowledging our past failures and choosing a different path forward. This app, while small and symbolic, is a testament to the idea that we can use the most advanced tools at our disposal to cultivate empathy rather than enmity
